designationHistory.indexText: Congress passed the Silvio O. Conte National Fish and Wildlife Refuge Act, signed December 11, 1991, which directed the establishment of the refuge along the Connecticut River.

authority.citation: Silvio O. Conte National Fish and Wildlife Refuge Act, Public Law 102-212, title I, 105 Stat. 1655

designationHistory.note: Pass A (2017 CCP: the 1991 Conte Refuge Act authorized the refuge) and Pass B (statute text: "An Act To establish the Silvio O. Conte National Fish and Wildlife Refuge," Dec. 11, 1991) agree. This is the authorizing act; see the 1997 event for when the refuge came into being.

sources.name: FWS, Silvio O. Conte NFWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan (2017), ch. 1

designationHistory.indexText: The refuge was officially established on October 3, 1997, when the Connecticut River Watershed Council donated Third Island in Deerfield, Massachusetts, to the Fish and Wildlife Service.

authority.citation: Donation of first parcel under the 1991 Conte Refuge Act

designationHistory.note: Only an FWS source was found for the October 3, 1997 date; a non-FWS confirmation (e.g. a 1997 newspaper report or the donor's records) is still needed.

sources.name: FWS, Silvio O. Conte NFWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan (2017), ch. 1 and 3
